notes:
A compound of ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧ (consecutive, serial) + ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧ (murder). Refers to a series of murders committed by the same perpetrator, typically with a cooling-off period between each killing. Commonly encountered in news reports and crime fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: serial murder case
- {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}{犯|はん}: serial killer
- {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧: serial murder suspect
- {連続殺人|れんぞくさつじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧: serial murder investigation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連続殺人犯|れんぞくさつじんはん}: serial killer (the perpetrator)
- ⟦{大量殺人|たいりょうさつじん}→大量殺人：23634_tairyousatsujin⟧: mass murder (many victims in a single event, not spread over time)
- ⟦{殺人事件|さつじんじけん}→殺人事件：30413_satsujinjiken⟧: murder case (a single murder incident)
- シリアルキラー: serial killer (loanword; used in casual media discussions)
